|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Redemption (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V5-L-redemption-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-redemption022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/redemption.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual5-Light/large/redemption.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•''Redemption''”. Text: “May add 4 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed, may deploy a non-[maintenance] Rebel aboard from your Lost Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Redemption (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 16 August 2023<ref name="img-redemption53572eb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/redemption.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 commit 53572eb] (16 August 2023); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual5-Light/large/redemption.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•''Redemption''” → “''Redemption''” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (348×488 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “''Redemption''”. It is the current image. Text: “May add 4 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed, may deploy a non-[maintenance] Rebel aboard from your Lost Pile.”
